notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Palinchron
When Vampire Charmseeker and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
